game_concept: A arcade set in Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle, a circle of glowing runes: the ruin warden must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle: a circle of glowing runes
core_gameplay_loop: In Rune Circle, repeat each round: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing. Each round, a new ancient keys challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the parade_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 600 points of ancient keys by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Reverse Parade
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Parade' (Week 7 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Rune Circle'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how parade_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Rune Circle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
